name: word-stream
title: Word Stream
description: Voiceover-paced phrases building word by word while the line drifts left.
useWhen: An intro or narration follows a voiceover and each phrase should build word by word at speaking pace.
Several short phrases play in sequence with fast cut-like swaps, the line drifting left as new words land.
avoidWhen: There is only one static phrase to reveal: use per-word-crossfade.
The words follow a real voiceover transcript: use caption-karaoke or another caption block.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Phrases separated by |. Words within a phrase are split on spaces.
variables.default: introducing | one-tap checkout | for your store

variables.label: Word gap
variables.description: Frames between words of a phrase (30 fps).

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: Frames a finished phrase stays before the next one cuts in.

variables.label: Drift
variables.description: How fast the whole line crawls left, in px per frame at 72 px type.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
